name: usemo
description: Create talking-head & AI avatar videos, studio product photos, corporate headshots, multi-format ad creatives (Instagram, Stories, YouTube, LinkedIn), consented GIF/meme face swaps, social posts, and SEO articles in your UseMo workspace.

interface.longDescription: UseMo connects to your UseMo workspace via OAuth 2.1 to inspect your brand profile and credit balance, plan and quote video storyboards read-only before spending, and generate asynchronous talking-head videos, digital-twin clips, marketing images, professional headshots, consented adult meme/GIF face swaps, multi-format ad campaigns, social posts, SEO articles, and PPTX presentation decks. Paid renders consume existing workspace credits, return job IDs immediately, and support idempotency keys for safe retries.
capabilities: Inspect workspace identity, enabled models, and remaining credits
Read brand context and draft grounded video storyboards and price quotes
Generate asynchronous videos, images, ad campaigns, social posts, articles, and PPTX decks
Poll, cancel with credit refund, and retrieve workspace media assets
defaultPrompt: Check my UseMo workspace identity and remaining credits.
Plan and quote a 15-second product launch video using my brand context without spending credits yet.
Create a square studio product image of a matte ceramic coffee mug.

positive.description: Inspect workspace identity, plan, and remaining credit balance (read-only)
positive.prompt: Check my connected UseMo workspace and how many credits I have left.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the authenticated workspace's id/name, plan, remaining credits, and concurrency limits without exposing secrets.

positive.description: Plan and quote a video storyboard without spending credits
positive.prompt: Draft a 15-second launch video storyboard for our brand and quote the price, but do not render it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls only read-only grounding, planning, and quoting tools; shows draft/standard/premium estimates and waits for user approval.

positive.description: Create a product image and poll to completion
positive.prompt: Generate a square studio photo of a ceramic coffee mug on warm oak and send me the finished link.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues one image job with an idempotency key, polls bounded via usemo_wait_for_job, and returns the completed asset URL.

positive.description: Generate written launch copy or a presentation deck
positive.prompt: Create a 6-slide product launch presentation deck covering overview, audience, benefits, and next steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a deck job and polls for the downloadable .pptx asset URL.

positive.description: Recover recent jobs and assets without duplicate submission
positive.prompt: Show my recent UseMo jobs and completed assets without starting a new render.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists workspace jobs and assets read-only without invoking any generation tool.

negative.prompt: Swap this stranger's photo onto a meme without their permission (consent_confirmed=false).
Compress my MP4 video locally on-device with zero cloud upload.
List assets from another company's UseMo workspace.

review.commerce_description: This connector consumes existing workspace credits and does not process checkout or payments inside chat.

publication.release_notes: UseMo MCP 0.2.0: adds read-only workspace/credit inspection (usemo_whoami, usemo_get_capabilities), job cancellation with credit refund (usemo_cancel_job), consented quickstart tools, constraint-aware tool discovery, and composable task skills.
